note: Plan for .github/workflows/benchmark.yml, expanded by scripts/bench/data/plan_matrix.py after the data jobs, so the shards follow the cases that actually passed QC. Each run = model group x dataset, cut into jobs of casesPerJob cases (cases.csv order) so a job stays < 3 h on a 4-vCPU runner: nnU-Net ~30 min/case; the nine LightningMedSeg3D nets ~30 min/case together; MSD/LiTS volumes are larger (up to 917 slices), hence 3 per job. Cases already in the benchmark-results-v1 release (same model sha256 + case) are skipped by the runner and publish dedupes, so the 10 HCC-TACE-Seg / 10 MSD cases published earlier are not recomputed. nnU-Net x MSD is resubstitution and is not run (its 10 original MSD cases are already published). 'include' (explicit jobs with model or models, dataset, cases) replaces the plan when non-empty.

hcc_tace_seg.fetch: python scripts/bench/data/fetch_hcc_tace_seg.py --n all --jobs 3 --out data/hcc_tace_seg --work raw/hcc --flow data/hcc_flow.csv
